messages:
Morgan: Heads-up: Vireo Labs onboarding — they asked for a formal SLO/SLA one-pager to include in the renewal packet. Need help defining uptime + latency credit calc. Can we sync today? @Akash @Elena
Akash: I can join. Quick Q — customer uses both hosted and dedicated endpoints. Do we cover both in the same doc or separate appendices?
Morgan: Prefer a single one-pager that calls out separate credit calcs per deployment type (hosted vs dedicated). Simpler for renewal committee.
Elena: From onboarding: integration peak ~50 req/s, p95 latency during testing ~180ms. They haven't flipped to Dedicated yet; still ramping.
Akash: Proposed SLOs: 99.9% uptime (monthly) for hosted, and p95 latency <= 250ms end-to-end. Credits: proportional to downtime beyond the 99.9% threshold, capped at 10% of monthly bill. Draft example below.
Akash: ```
# SLO uptime calc (monthly)
SLO_uptime = (Total_healthy_minutes / Total_minutes_in_month) * 100
Downtime_for_credit = max(0, Threshold_minutes - healthy_minutes_lost)
Credit = min(Max_cap, (Downtime_for_credit / Total_minutes_in_month) * Monthly_fee)
```
Toni: Heads-up on renewals: if credits exceed ~5% in any quarter, the customer will often surface this as a renewal risk. Suggest we: (a) cap at 10% but (b) offer a one-time onboarding exception for issues in month-1.
Frank: Finance note — we need exact wording + a sample invoice line showing the credit math. If cap=10% please show a 2% and 7% example in USD so account execs can reason about impact. Also specify billing period assumptions.
Morgan: Action items: @Akash produce the one-pager + worked examples; @Elena collect p95/p99 telemetry and add a sample CSV; @Frank prepare sample invoice lines; @Toni draft renewal messaging. Target: draft by EOD Thursday.
DevOpsBot: Incident logged: INC-2021-374 — 2101233000 — region-us-east transient GPU node failure caused ~12m partial degraded capacity on hosted inference.
Akash: Noted — that 12m will show in the hosted uptime calc; I'll include a worked example showing how 12 minutes maps to the credit and show both per-deployment and consolidated views.
Morgan: :thumbsup: Also include a "what's not covered" bullet (customer-managed infra, network third-party outages). I'll schedule a 30m sync after drafts are in.
Elena: I'll drop telemetry CSV + quick perf dashboard link into the shared drive and ping this thread when uploaded.
Toni: If they ask for escalation path in the SLA, include: P0 support channel, 4h initial response target, and exec escalation for credits >5%.
Morgan: Great — I'll assemble and loop in the assigned CSM before we send the one-pager to the customer. Thanks all.
